main.description: A calibration profile for a metering instrument — most importantly a phone acting as a meter, where each camera module and sensor path needs its own correction. Stored in the repo so profiles roam across app installs. A reading references the profile that was applied to it, keeping every value auditable.

referenceDetail.description: The specific reference, e.g. 'Sekonic L-758DR s/n …', 'sunny-16, clear noon 2026-06-14'.

offsetStops.description: Global correction applied to raw engine EV, in stops (positive = engine reads dark).

constantK.description: Reflected-light calibration constant K in cd·s/(m²·ISO) this profile targets (default 12.5).

constantCFlat.description: Incident flat-receptor constant C in lx·s/ISO (commonly 250).

constantCDome.description: Incident hemispherical-receptor constant C in lx·s/ISO (commonly 330).

curve.description: Optional non-linear correction: (engine EV → corrected EV) control points, interpolated linearly between points.

validEvMin.description: Lower bound of the validated range (EV100).

validEvMax.description: Upper bound of the validated range (EV100).

deviceModel.description: Hardware identifier the profile was made on, e.g. 'iPhone17,2', so a restored account on new hardware knows to recalibrate.

osVersion.description: OS build at calibration time; camera pipelines change between releases.

supersedes.description: Previous calibration this one replaces, forming an auditable chain.
